# Breez SDK - Spark

> End-to-end SDK for instant, non-custodial bitcoin and stablecoin payments, with bindings for nine languages. Start from the language edition matching your project's dependency, listed directly below. Every page is also published as markdown at the same path with a `.md` extension.

## Language editions

Each edition carries every page listed below, with examples in one language only and identifiers in that language's naming convention.

- [Rust](/llms/rust/llms.txt): for the `breez-sdk-spark` crate. [Whole book in one file](/llms-rust-full.txt).
- [Swift](/llms/swift/llms.txt): for the `breez-sdk-spark-swift` Swift package. [Whole book in one file](/llms-swift-full.txt).
- [Kotlin](/llms/kotlin/llms.txt): for `technology.breez.spark:breez-sdk-spark-kmp` or `breez_sdk_spark:bindings-android`. [Whole book in one file](/llms-kotlin-full.txt).
- [C#](/llms/csharp/llms.txt): for the `Breez.Sdk.Spark` NuGet package. [Whole book in one file](/llms-csharp-full.txt).
- [Javascript (Wasm)](/llms/wasm/llms.txt): for the `@breeztech/breez-sdk-spark` npm package. [Whole book in one file](/llms-wasm-full.txt).
- [React Native](/llms/react-native/llms.txt): for the `@breeztech/breez-sdk-spark-react-native` npm package. [Whole book in one file](/llms-react-native-full.txt).
- [Flutter](/llms/flutter/llms.txt): for the `breez_sdk_spark_flutter` pub package. [Whole book in one file](/llms-flutter-full.txt).
- [Python](/llms/python/llms.txt): for the `breez-sdk-spark` PyPI package. [Whole book in one file](/llms-python-full.txt).
- [Go](/llms/go/llms.txt): for the `github.com/breez/breez-sdk-spark-go` module. [Whole book in one file](/llms-go-full.txt).
